summary.document_scope: 6 chapters, all with synthetic genealogy tables and summary rows. Most chapters use a 7-column header (NAME, BORN, MARRIED, SPOUSE, BOY, GIRL, DIED) with a separate summary/total table. One chapter (chapter-004.html) uses a fused BOYGIRL header. Issues include one instance each of multi-table fragmentation, concatenated subgroup/context rows, a fused BOYGIRL header, and a child note in the wrong column.
summary.default_note_policy: Notes and child annotations should not be placed in the DIED column; marginal or child notes should be attached to the correct individual or family row, not misfiled in unrelated columns.
summary.default_note_policy_rationale: The majority of chapters do not show child or marginal notes in the DIED column, and only one chapter (chapter-005.html) has a semantic placement error. This suggests the intended convention is to keep such notes out of the DIED column for clarity and consistency.
